verdict.rationale: Modal documents a dedicated sandbox "Filesystem Access" guide (modal-docs-8), which shows the product ships its own filesystem capability. The JS/Go SDK docs show mounting a Volume into a sandbox and reading a file through `sb.exec(["cat", ...])` (modal-docs-20, modal-docs-21). The pack never shows SDK calls for reading, writing, uploading, or downloading files, so how far the capability goes is unproven. missing for 10: explicit SDK file read/write API evidence, upload/download from the local machine to the sandbox, method-level reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
